world_read.summary: A dense, left-weighted printed composition places a salmon-shirt portrait beside an enlarged pale-cyan face, joined visually by a narrow cream strip with blue ornament. Large outlined lettering crosses the lower cluster. A broad indigo field remains open on the right. The result has substantial negative space but is more figurative and typographically busy than minimal expressionism.
